lecture_visualizations_size_positive.name: lecture_visualizations_size_positive
lecture_visualizations_size_positive.value: ("lecture_visualizations"."width_px" IS NULL OR "lecture_visualizations"."width_px" > 0) AND ("lecture_visualizations"."height_px" IS NULL OR "lecture_visualizations"."height_px" > 0)

class_recordings_ends_after_starts.name: class_recordings_ends_after_starts
class_recordings_ends_after_starts.value: "class_recordings"."recording_ended_at" IS NULL OR "class_recordings"."recording_started_at" IS NULL OR "class_recordings"."recording_ended_at" > "class_recordings"."recording_started_at"

live_classes_ends_after_starts.name: live_classes_ends_after_starts
live_classes_ends_after_starts.value: "live_classes"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "live_classes"."started_at" IS NULL OR "live_classes"."ended_at" > "live_classes"."started_at"

presentation_slides_hex_colors.name: presentation_slides_hex_colors
presentation_slides_hex_colors.value: ("presentation_slides"."background_color" IS NULL OR "presentation_slides"."background_color" ~ '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$') AND ("presentation_slides"."text_color" IS NULL OR "presentation_slides"."text_color" ~ '^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$')

presentation_submissions_grade_consisten.name: presentation_submissions_grade_consistent
presentation_submissions_grade_consisten.value: ("presentation_submissions"."graded_at" IS NULL AND "presentation_submissions"."score" IS NULL) OR ("presentation_submissions"."graded_at" IS NOT NULL AND "presentation_submissions"."score" IS NOT NULL)
